title: Azithromycin Treatment for Respiratory Syncytial Virus-induced Respiratory Failure in Children
official: Azithromycin Treatment for Respiratory Syncytial Virus-induced Respiratory Failure in Children
summary: The overarching hypothesis of the ARRC trial is that administration of Azithromycin (AZM) during acute, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV)-induced respiratory failure will be beneficial, mediated through the matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)-9 pathway.
